question: How can the pure aghora powers also be related to the terrible powers and the cosmic functions?
premises: There are terrible and more terrible powers.
The aghora powers are their source.
The same powers operate in creation, maintenance, dissolution, and beyond those three conditions.
inference: Because they are the source of the terrible powers, the aghora powers are essentially related to them and pervade creation, maintenance, dissolution, and the transcendence of that triad.
uncertainties: The verse compresses the relation between sourcehood and identity; the exact ontological nuance is brief.
plain_english: Because they are the source of the terrible and more terrible powers, those same aghora powers are of that nature too; they operate in creation, maintenance, and dissolution, and also in the transcendence of those three conditions.
